evolution.name: Baseline Elo + Dixon-Coles Goals
evolution.description: Pure historical goals & multi-division Elo vs pre-match odds (no xG, fatigue, or squad context).

evolution.name: + Shot-xG & Finishing Luck Regression
evolution.description: Fades unsustainable clinical goal conversion (Goals - Shot-xG) and rewards territorial dominance & schedule strength.

evolution.name: + Mid-Week UCL/Europe & Cup Congestion
evolution.description: Penalizes clubs playing within 5 days of UEFA Champions/Europa League or domestic cup ties and high 14-day congestion.

evolution.name: + Squad Availability, FPL Injury Shock & Suspensions
evolution.description: Integrates pre-deadline FPL transfer-out shocks on top-5 ICT stars, star minutes missing, and red-card suspensions.

evolution.name: Full 6-Pillar Alpha Formula + Sharp Market Anchor
evolution.description: Combines all 6 domain pillars with Pinnacle sharp-vs-retail divergence and regime-calibrated EV thresholds.

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 1: Finishing & Points Luck Regression
pillar_analytics.description: Fades teams scoring above Shot-xG & xPts over prior 5-10 matches

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 2: Mid-Week UCL/Europe & Cup Fatigue
pillar_analytics.description: Penalizes mid-week UEFA/Cup turnaround, 14-day congestion & rest deficit

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 3: Star Injury Shock & Suspensions
pillar_analytics.description: Penalizes top-5 ICT star absences, FPL pre-deadline transfer-out shocks & red cards

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 4: Shot-xG, Corners & Schedule Strength
pillar_analytics.description: Rewards underlying Shot-xG edge, corner dominance & opponent Elo schedule

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 5: Sharp (Pinnacle) vs Soft Divergence
pillar_analytics.description: Captures syndicate money steamed into Pinnacle vs lagging retail bookmakers

pillar_analytics.title: Pillar 6: Draw Equilibrium & Parity
pillar_analytics.description: Boosts draw probability in low-pi-diff matches with dual-team congestion
